description: Implementation of SOCKS client socket handling SOCKS4 protocol, including connection setup, handshake, and data transmission.

classes.name: SOCKS4ServerRequest
classes.description: Struct representing SOCKS4 server request header with version, command, port, and IP.

classes.name: SOCKS4ServerResponse
classes.description: Struct representing SOCKS4 server response with reserved null, response code, port, and IP.

classes.name: SOCKSClientSocket
classes.description: Class implementing SOCKS4 client socket handling connection, handshake, and data transfer over a transport socket.

methods.name: BuildHandshakeWriteBuffer
methods.description: Constructs the SOCKS4 handshake request buffer to send to the server.

methods.name: DoResolveHost
methods.description: Initiates hostname resolution for the target destination.

methods.name: DoResolveHostComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of hostname resolution, proceeding to handshake if successful.

methods.name: DoHandshakeWrite
methods.description: Sends the handshake request to the SOCKS server.

methods.name: DoHandshakeWriteComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of handshake request sending, proceeding to read response.

methods.name: DoHandshakeRead
methods.description: Reads the SOCKS server response to handshake.

methods.name: DoHandshakeReadComplete
methods.description: Processes the server response, determining success or failure of handshake.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop managing connection states and transitions.
